name: How much does an accessibility remodel typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an accessibility remodel typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an accessibility remodel varies significantly based on the scope of work and materials chosen. Minor adjustments, such as installing grab bars or a comfort-height toilet, are less expensive. Larger projects like a roll-in shower, ramp construction, or kitchen modifications can range from several thousands to tens of thousands of dollars. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for accessibility remodels vary widely depending on the project's scope, from minor adjustments to major structural changes.
